newsitem.title: USA: Charles Stewart Mott CC, Mich., won by First of America. [CORRECTED 00:49 GMT 29/10]
newsitem.headline: Charles Stewart Mott CC, Mich., won by First of America. [CORRECTED 00:49 GMT 29/10]

text.p: (Corrects to show that First of America won and not Painewebber Inc.)

First of America , said it won $2.250 million of Charles Stewart Mott Community College, Mich., general obligation energy conservation limited tax notes, Series 1996, with a net interest cost of 4.93 percent (corrects figure from 4.90 percent).
